claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Nikon DSLR body with Nikon branding, but the exact model number/name is not readable in the photo.
Witness report confirms a Nikon lens with zoom/focus rings, but focal length/aperture markings are not readable.
Witness only notes used condition with no obvious cracks visible; scratches/dents/wear on lens glass and sensor area are not shown.

risks.risk: Exact camera model may not be D810 (could be another Nikon DSLR), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the camera model name/number (e.g., on the top/bottom plate) and the lens label showing focal length (e.g., '24-70mm').
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified used Nikon DSLR body with an unknown lens.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 24-70mm (could be different focal length or a non-matching/third-party lens).
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the lens front ring/side text showing the exact lens model and focal length/aperture.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Nikon DSLR with an unknown lens.

risks.risk: Functionality unknown (autofocus, stabilization, shutter actuation, buttons/ports).
risks.proof: A short video showing autofocus working on a target, plus a menu screen showing shutter count (or EXIF/shutter count tool output).

risks.risk: Sensor and lens glass condition unknown (scratches, fungus, haze, dust affecting images).
risks.proof: Photos of the sensor at high magnification (or a test shot of a blank wall/sky showing dust) and close-ups of lens glass under light.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for visible wear/possible cleaning needs.

risks.risk: Accessories and completeness unknown (battery, charger, memory card, caps/hood/strap/manual/box).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo showing every included item: battery model, charger, memory card, lens hood, front/rear caps, strap, manuals/box.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (no guarantee of battery/charger/memory card/caps).

risks.risk: Potential scam/overclaim risk if the seller’s stated model/lens don’t match what’s shown.
risks.proof: Match photos: camera model plate + lens label + serial number close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case and treat as 'model not confirmed'.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model name/number (top or bottom plate) and serial number.
Clear close-up photo of the lens side/front text showing exact focal length (e.g., 24-70mm) and lens model.
Video test: autofocus locks on a subject; show image stabilization behavior if applicable.
Photo/video of the camera menu showing shutter count (or a shutter count readout).
Close-up photos of lens glass (front and rear) under light; and a sensor check photo or a test shot showing dust.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, memory card, lens hood, caps, strap, manuals/box).
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nikon DSLR body and an attached zoom lens, but the exact D810 model and 24-70mm lens details are not readable. Without those confirmations and basic functionality/accessory checks, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
